strings.alarm_readiness_description: Kwezinye izixhobo, ngakumbi i-Xiaomi/MIUI, ii-alam zinokulibaziseka okanye zingavakali xa usetyenziso luvaliwe. Jonga izinto ezingezantsi ukuze uphucule ukuthembeka.

strings.alarm_notifications_not_ready: Izaziso zicinyiwe. Izilumkiso ze-alam zinokufihlwa okanye zithintelwe.
strings.alarm_exact_not_ready: Ii-alam ezichanekileyo azivunyelwanga. Ii-alam zokuvuka zisenokungakhali ngexesha.
strings.alarm_battery_not_ready: Ukuphuculwa kwebhetri kusasebenza. I-Xiaomi/MIUI inokulibazisa okanye ithintele ii-alam xa usetyenziso luvaliwe.
strings.alarm_app_settings_description: Vula iphepha loseto losetyenziso ukuze ujonge ukuziqalisa, umsebenzi ongasemva, indlela esebenza ngayo isikrini sokutshixa kunye neemvume ezikhethekileyo zomenzi.

strings.alarm_gate_battery_hint: Ulungiso lwebhetri luvula kuqala useto losetyenziso. Kwezinye izixhobo, emva koko vumela ukusetyenziswa ngasemva okanye ususe imida yebhetri yolu setyenziso.

strings.settings_permissions_header_body: Iimvume zee-alam nezee-alam zendawo, ukufikelela kwindawo noseto lokuthembeka olukhethekileyo lwesixhobo ziqokelelwe apha.

strings.settings_backup_restore_confirm_body: Useto lwangoku losetyenziso, ii-alam, iiwotshi, isibali-xesha, idatha yesitophuwotshi, amanqaku neefayile zezandi zamanqaku ziza kutshintshwa yifayile yogcino ekhethiweyo.
strings.settings_backup_restore_restart_body: Idatha yogcino ibuyiselwe ngempumelelo. Qala usetyenziso kwakhona ukuze lonke useto, ii-alam, iiwotshi, isibali-xesha kunye nedatha yesitophuwotshi ebuyiselweyo iboniswe kakuhle.

Imo engasebenzisi intanethi isebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi, kodwa umgangatho unokuba sezantsi kuba ukusetyenzwa kwenzeka kwifowuni kwaye kuxhomekeke kwimodeli ekhethiweyo.

strings.settings_speech_models_button_body: Khuphela uze ulawule iimodeli zokuguqula ilizwi libe ngumbhalo ukuze kuqondwe ngaphandle kweintanethi.
strings.settings_speech_models_header_body: Khuphela iimodeli zentetho zokuguqula ilizwi libe ngumbhalo ngaphandle kweintanethi. Iimodeli zigcinwa kwesi sixhobo kwaye zijongwa nge-SHA-256 ngaphambi kokufakwa.
strings.settings_speech_models_load_failed: Imanifesti yeemodeli zentetho ayikwazanga ukulayishwa. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uze uzame kwakhona.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_no_models: Akukho modeli zingasebenzisi intanethi ezifakiweyo. Vula Iimodeli zentetho ezingasebenzisi intanethi kuSeto uze ukhuphele imodeli kuqala.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_h: Ukuqondwa ngaphandle kweintanethi kusebenza ngaphandle kweintanethi. Umgangatho uxhomekeke kwimodeli ekhethiweyo, amandla efowuni neemeko zemakrofoni. Ukufumana ukuchaneka okuphezulu, sebenzisa ukuqondwa kwi-intanethi.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_s: Umgangatho wangaphandle kweintanethi unokuba sezantsi kunowekwi-intanethi kuba ukusetyenzwa kwenzeka kwifowuni.
strings.geo_alarm_empty_body: Yenza i-alam esekelwe kwindawo yokungena okanye yokuphuma kwindawo ekhethiweyo.
strings.geo_alarm_stage1_body: Eli nqanaba ligcina ii-alam zendawo, uxilongo nedatha yogcino. Iimvume zendawo nokuhanjiswa kwe-geofence yokwenene ziza kudityaniswa kwinqanaba elilandelayo.
strings.geo_alarm_delete_confirm_body: Le alam yendawo iza kucinywa ngokusisigxina.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_latitude: I-latitude kufuneka ibe phakathi kuka--90 no-90.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_longitude: I-longitude kufuneka ibe phakathi kuka--180 no-180.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_data: Jonga idatha ye-alam yendawo uze uzame kwakhona.
strings.settings_diagnostics_geo_alarm_body: Iziganeko zokwenza, ukuhlela, ugcino, ukubuyisela nokuhanjiswa kwe-geofence kwixesha elizayo.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_log_empty_body: Yenza okanye hlela ii-alam zendawo, ilog yeziganeko iza kuvela apha.
strings.geo_alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Zonke iziganeko zoxilongo lwe-alam yendawo ezigciniweyo ziza kucinywa ngokusisigxina.
strings.geo_alarm_stage2_body: Iimvume zendawo nokubhaliswa kwe-geofence kudityanisiwe. Xa indawo egciniweyo iqaliswa, usetyenziso lubhala uxilongo luze lubonise isaziso. Ukukhala okupheleleyo kuza kudityaniswa kwinqanaba elilandelayo.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_package2_body: Ukubhaliswa kwe-geofence, ukubuyisela emva kokuqalisa, isamkeli sotshintsho, uxilongo nokuhanjiswa kwezaziso kuvuliwe.
strings.geo_alarm_reliability_body: Ii-alam ezisekelwe kwindawo zifuna ukufikelela kwindawo, indawo yangasemva nezaziso. I-Android isenokulibazisa iziganeko ze-geofence ukuze yonge ibhetri.
strings.geo_alarm_permission_precise_missing: Kukho indawo eqikelelweyo kuphela okanye akukho kufikelela
strings.geo_alarm_permission_background_missing: Vumela ngalo lonke ixesha kuseto losetyenziso
strings.geo_alarm_vendor_hint_body: Kwi-Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, MIUI okanye HyperOS, vumela ukuziqalisa uze ususe imida yebhetri ye-ShiftAlarm. Kungenjalo iziganeko ze-geofence zinokufika emva kwexesha.
strings.geo_alarm_stage21_body: Eli nqanaba longeza iindlela ezimfutshane zeemvume, amacebiso okuthembeka noxilongo oluneenkcukacha. Ukukhala okupheleleyo kuza kudityaniswa emva kokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kwe-geofence.
strings.geo_alarm_ringing_channel_description: Isandi, ukungcangcazela nezaziso zesikrini esigcweleyo ze-alam yendawo
strings.geo_alarm_cooldown_hint_body: Ukuqalisa okuphindaphindiweyo kotshintsho olufanayo lwe-alam yendawo kunokungahoywa imizuzu embalwa ukuze kuthintelwe ukukhala okuphindaphindiweyo kufutshane nomda wendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_duplicate_protection_body: Ukhuseleko lokuphindaphinda: isiganeko esifanayo sokungena okanye sokuphuma asiyi kuphinda sikhale imizuzu emi-3. Isiganeko esichaseneyo sisenokukhala.
strings.geo_alarm_map_location_unavailable: Indawo yangoku ayifumaneki. Zama kwakhona ngaphandle okanye ujonge useto lwendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_map_bookmarks_later: Iindawo ezigciniweyo ziza kongezwa kwinqanaba elahlukileyo.
strings.geo_alarm_map_provider_later: I-Google Maps, Yandex Maps, imaleko yesathelayithi neyomxube zigcinelwe iiphakheji ezizayo. Iphakheji yangoku isebenzisa i-OpenStreetMap.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_step_hint: Irediyasi itshintsha ngamanyathelo angama-200 m. Ubuninzi: 5000 m.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_reliability_warning: Irediyasi engaphantsi kwe-800 m inokusebenza emva kwexesha ngenxa yokonga ibhetri nokuchaneka kwendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_android_hint: Ukuze i-alam yendawo isebenze ngokuthembeka, kuyacetyiswa i-800–1000 m.
strings.geo_alarm_map_search_not_found: Idilesi ayifunyenwanga. Zama umbuzo opheleleyo: isixeko, isitalato nenombolo yendlu.
strings.geo_alarm_map_reverse_geocode_online_fir: Ukukhangelwa kwedilesi kuqala kusebenzisa idatha ye-intanethi, emva koko kusetyenziswa i-geocoder yesixhobo xa inethiwekhi ingafumaneki.

strings.settings_permissions_alarm_geo_summary_b: Seta ukuthembeka kwee-alam zokuvuka, ukufikelela kwindawo kwee-alam zendawo noseto lwebhetri endaweni enye.
strings.settings_permissions_geo_first_launch_bo: Ii-alam zendawo zifuna ukufikelela kwindawo, indawo echanekileyo nendawo yangasemva ukuze zisebenze xa usetyenziso luvaliwe. Ungazivula kuseto losetyenziso.

strings.settings_backup_save_body: Yenza ifayile yogcino uze ukhethe apho iza kugcinwa khona kwesi sixhobo.
strings.settings_backup_share_body: Yenza ifayile yogcino uze uvule isikrini senkqubo sokwabelana ukuze uyithumele nge-imeyile, umyalezo okanye kugcino lwamafu.

strings.legal_documents_intro_body: Amaxwebhu ayafumaneka ngaphandle kweintanethi. Xa i-intanethi ifumaneka, i-ShiftAlarm inokukhuphela iinguqulelo zangoku ize isebenzise iikopi eziqukiweyo xa kuyimfuneko.
strings.legal_privacy_body: Indlela elawulwa ngayo idatha yasekuhlaleni yosetyenziso, uxilongo nokukhutshelwa.
strings.legal_disclaimer_body: Imida ebalulekileyo yokuthembeka kwee-alam, izaziso nee-geofence.
strings.legal_help_body: Isikhokelo esingasebenzisi intanethi semisebenzi ephambili yosetyenziso.
strings.legal_document_unavailable_body: Uxwebhu alukwazanga ukuvulwa. Jonga uqhagamshelo okanye uzame kwakhona kamva.
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_body: I-ShiftAlarm idibanisa iishedyuli zeeshifti, ii-alam, ii-alam zendawo, amanqaku, iiwijethi nezixhobo zogcino. Isikrini esiphambili sele sifumaneka emva kwale festile yokuseta.
strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Nceda uvule amaxwebhu osetyenziso uze wamkele iinguqulelo ezifunekayo. Achaza imigaqo yokusetyenziswa, ubumfihlo nemida yokuthembeka kwee-alam, izaziso nee-alam zendawo.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: Iimvume azifuneki ukuze ujonge usetyenziso, kodwa ii-alam, izikhumbuzo nee-alam zendawo zixhomekeke kwizaziso, ii-alam ezichanekileyo, indawo noseto lwebhetri.
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Ungagqiba ngoku uze ubuyele kwiimvume kamva kuSeto.
strings.settings_help_training_button_body: Vula isikhokelo somsebenzisi esingasebenzisi intanethi kwifestile eyahlukileyo yesikhangeli.

strings.help_training_offer_hint: Isikhokelo sivuleka njengephepha lasekuhlaleni elahlukileyo, ukuze utshintshe phakathi kwesikhokelo nosetyenziso ngoxa ulandela amanyathelo.
